payload.body: Git discipline for nahel projects (added after codex dogfood gap #3, where an agent built a feature on main): code changes go on epic/fix/chore branches to a reviewed PR with human-gated merge; nahel STATE commits (journal, items, observations) go directly to the default branch as the merge-safe exception. Stated as step 0 of task-lifecycle.md with branch notes in epic-decompose.md and bug-lane.md.
